svg.text: nrw model new --from-notes · how the stack is proposed
Facts come from the files, judgement from the notes: one system + one user message to the endpoint, and only seven keys of the reply may reach the spec
INPUTS
PROMPT (spec/authoring.py build_prompt)
LLM CALL & OUTPUT

g.text: "You are helping a neutron reflectometry scientist at SNS REF_L
(BL-4B) turn their notes into an `nrw-model/1` model specification."
"The reference material below is the project's own skills.
Follow them; they carry this beamline's conventions and the schema."
"Propose the physics half of the spec, and only that."
Return a single JSON object with these keys and no others:

text.tspan: the order nrw reads as back reflection
"probe" {"back_reflection": true} ONLY if the notes say so

svg.text: Rules (abridged; every one is in the prompt):
- never return states, series, thetas, data_dir, run, reduced_dir,
schema, name or sample: read from disk, and discarded anyway
- prefer FEWER layers: under about 30 Å a layer is barely resolvable
- the ambient from the notes and EACH MEASUREMENT; never assume air;
one ambient rho per state where the solvents differ
- a series needs `constraints`; the form from the evidence:
linear_in_time (default) · linear_in_index · logistic · exponential
· piecewise_linear · free · fixed; `from`/`to` may be `free`
- `paths`: the notes decide; silent notes → the assessment
(oscillatory template → a thickness, one-sign → an SLD)
- scope from the notes' words: per: measurement | state (+ in:) | model
- nuisance terms read from the notes: theta_offset (per: model unless
remounted), sample_broadening (per: angle), background,
intensity (per: state)
- "Output JSON only. No markdown fence, no commentary outside the JSON."

text.tspan: or "(empty -- the scientist has not written anything yet)"

g.text: "This part is already correct. Do not change it; use its names."
===== EACH MEASUREMENT, AS THE NOTES DESCRIBE IT =====

next: nrw model validate · preview · generate

svg.text: NO CALL · the scaffold is written either way, with the stack left as a placeholder
--print-prompt alone
Prints agent_instructions(): seven steps that name the
files instead of inlining them, and a different request:
four editable keys, no measured facts, the stack's LAST
entry as the incident medium. With --from-notes as well,
the call is made and this is printed after it.
NRW_AGENT=1 · a harness is driving
--from-notes becomes --print-prompt. A harness asking
a weaker model to do the part it is best at is the
wrong way round, so the harness gets the instruction.
no endpoint configured
Says how to get one: LLM_PROVIDER=claude_code (the
Claude Code CLI, no key), or LLM_PROVIDER and
LLM_API_KEY, or --print-prompt.
no flag
Plain nrw model new never calls a model: the
placeholder, headed "The stack below is a
PLACEHOLDER -- replace it …"
